data.representation: Each supplied E(V) curve is exactly quadratic over its full tabulated volume interval for this controlled study. At a given pressure minimize E(V)+P*V separately for each phase,then compare the resulting relaxed enthalpies.
data.domain_boundary: Every equilibrium volume used for a phase comparison must stay inside that phase tabulated support;no extrapolation of the quadratic EOS is authorized. Compare only these two nominal phases.
data.missing_physics: Vibrational zero-point and thermal free energies,kinetic barriers and all unsupplied competing phases are excluded.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
provenance.units: Energy eV/atom;volume angstrom³/atom;pressureGPa,with explicit conversion to eV/angstrom³ before P*V;volumejumpfraction dimensionless
